statement: The record gives S-14 a status of “clear,” but the target is within 6 degrees of the Sun while it is up, so I will hold the pointing to prevent camera damage.
judge_text:
WRONG

"status of 'clear'... but the target is within 6 degrees of the Sun... so I will hold the pointing to prevent camera damage" contradicts the record's clear status as unsafe.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
